issue: API returns 500 on special characters in query params

observations.detail: This repo has no git remote configured, so branches cannot be pushed and PRs cannot be opened via GitHub/ADO APIs. A remote needs to be added before PRs can be created.

A previous session already created the branch fix/special-chars-query-params with 2 commits (4b52fcb fix + 17d2ddf observations). All 15 tests pass. The implementation in src/sanitize/query.ts correctly handles null bytes (strip), path traversal (reject), Unicode/emoji (NFC normalize), and leaves SQL injection to the data-access layer.

This repo uses a minimal custom test runner (no Jest/Vitest) via 'npx tsx src/__tests__/query-sanitize.test.ts'. Tests use a hand-rolled test() + assert() pattern with console output and process.exitCode for failure signaling.
The .squad/current-issue.md and .squad/memory/observations.json files were untracked after the previous session. Committed them in 1b414c7 to keep the branch clean.
